reasons: The only non-compete/exclusivity covenant in the cited text (Section 5.8.1) binds Harpoon (the licensor/counterparty) and its Affiliates, and the rule's detection guidance expressly states that restrictions binding the Vendor are acceptable; the Section 5.8.2 carve-outs plus AbbVie's information cut-off and Segregation rights operate in our favour.

AbbVie (our party, as licensee) is subject only to the Section 10.4 covenants regarding obtaining IP rights from Affiliates, Sublicensees and personnel, which is not a field-of-use or competitive restriction; Field/Territory limits on the licence grant are grant-scope, not restrictive covenants, consistent with the rationale.

Claimed status is 'compliant', and correctly no redline or counterparty comment was proposed — the rendered text is unchanged and the deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') passes.

Rationale documents the search terms used ('compet', 'Competing Product', 'AbbVie shall not', 'neither Party shall', 'directly or indirectly') and reaches the preferred position (no non-compete on Customer); retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
